notes.title: NEW DLC - Attention all fans of A Match With a Fantasy Witch!
notes.notes:
Attention all fans of A Match With a Fantasy Witch! We are excited to announce the release of our new DLC pack, filled with wallpapers and artworks featuring concept art and glimpses into the future of the main game.

This DLC pack is a must-have for any fan of A Match With a Fantasy Witch, as it includes exclusive artwork and behind-the-scenes glimpses at what's in store for the game in the future. Plus, the high-quality wallpapers included in the pack are perfect for sprucing up your desktop or mobile device.

Don't miss out on this opportunity to dive deeper into the world of A Match With a Fantasy Witch and get a sneak peek at what's to come. The DLC pack is now available for purchase on Steam.

We can't wait for you to check out all the amazing content included in this pack, and we hope you enjoy it as much as we enjoyed creating it. Thank you for your support of A Match With a Fantasy Witch!

notes.title: News About Everything you need to know!
notes.notes:
Hello my dear players. We are in the final stretch of our last game, from this release I will not be releasing any more games on steam (at least not with this account).
It's been 6 years since I've been working with games and with each game I've tried to improve more and more, because I honestly know that the other games didn't have much quality, I was learning. However, I consider this my masterpiece, it's a short game, with a short story, but it's intended to amuse them a little. Until the release I intend to add archivements and everything possible to make your interaction with the game the best possible. Thanks in advance to all of you who followed my games and were willing to play them, it was a beautiful journey, I hope you enjoy what's to come. Thank you so much.
